title: Beneficiary's Election of a Commuted Value — Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year and 20-Year Certain
content:
**Right of election.** On a period-certain tier of Income Annuities that allows beneficiary commutation, the beneficiary receiving the remaining certain installments after the annuitant's death within the period certain may sign an election to take their commuted value in one sum instead of continuing payments, while at least the tier's minimum number of remaining payments for commutation are left. The election carries the commuted value, the federal withholding rate the beneficiary chooses for the lump sum and how the beneficiary wants to be paid.

**When the value is fixed.** The commuted value is fixed only after every certain installment that fell due between the date of death and the approval of the death claim stands issued to the beneficiary on the contract's activity history.

Put the other way, in the same terms: while the contract's activity history shows any certain installment with a payment date after the date of death and on or before the approval of the death claim that does not stand issued to the beneficiary, the commuted value is not yet fixed.

| Element of the election | What it records |
|---|---|
| Who signs | The beneficiary receiving the remaining certain installments |
| What is given up | The continuing certain installments |
| What is received | Their commuted value, in one sum |
| Carried on the election | The commuted value, the federal withholding rate chosen for the lump sum, the way the beneficiary wants to be paid |
| Tiers | Period-certain tiers that allow beneficiary commutation, while at least the minimum number of remaining payments for commutation are left |

**Effect.** The signed election is filed on the contract as an approved commutation election signed by the beneficiary, linked to the approved death claim; the beneficiary can see it at once.

## The beneficiary's election tool: `elect_commuted_value_be644418`

**Capability.** The beneficiary receiving the remaining certain installments of an Ashgrove period-certain income annuity signs, in person, an election to take the commuted value of those installments in one sum instead of continuing payments. One call files the signed election on the contract as an approved commutation election carrying the commuted value accepted, the federal withholding rate the beneficiary chose for the lump sum and how the beneficiary wants to be paid, linked to the approved death claim.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hand it over; the customer themselves — the beneficiary signing the election — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `income_contract_id` | Reference number of the income annuity contract whose remaining certain installments are commuted, from the income annuity contract lookup | Identifier as recorded |
| `income_request_id` | Reference number of the approved death claim on that contract, from the income annuity service request lookup | Identifier as recorded |
| `payee_customer_id` | Customer reference number of the beneficiary signing the election, from the customer profile lookup | Identifier as recorded |
| `commuted_value` | The commuted value of the remaining certain installments that the beneficiary accepts | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `requested_withholding_pct` | The federal income tax withholding rate the beneficiary chooses for the lump sum | Decimal with 2 decimal places: 0.20 for 20 percent, 0.00 for no withholding |
| `disbursement_method` | How the beneficiary wants the lump sum paid | `check` (a paper check mailed) or `direct_deposit` (to the deposit account on the contract's payment instructions) |

**Return.** A receipt line beginning "Election filed:", giving the new commutation election reference number, the contract reference number, the commuted value accepted in USD with 2 decimal places and the withholding rate chosen. A receipt beginning "Election filed" means the election stands approved on the contract.
